The '''Keshiri religion''' was commonly followed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], and revolved around tales of the [[Skyborn]] and the [[Otherside]], who were believed to have [[Great Battle|battled]] in the [[Star/Legends|stars]]. The Skyborn won the so-called Great Battle but were wounded, and their [[Blood/Legends|blood]] formed the Kesh's landmass. After the arrival of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], the Skyborn myths were changed, instead featuring the Protectors and the Destructors.
